name: NATURAL WATER LOCK

r4_phone_review_input.interpretation: Real pixel motion and anchor stability are proven; only the visible water-motion model is replaced in R4B.

r4_visual_fail_diagnosis.primary_cause: Shared global sine/cosine phase equations and amplified Proof Water displacement produced coherent, readable rhythmic deformation.

natural_flow_model.type: fixed-seed, asynchronously evolving multi-scale vector field

layers.role: local interference and independent flow regions

natural_flow_model.sampling: Smoothstep bilinear interpolation over three differently rotated grids.
natural_flow_model.temporal_behavior: Each node evolves with independently seeded non-commensurate rates and a separate gradual energy envelope; layer-global energy is limited to a small modulation.

boundary_behavior.attenuation: Raster 8-neighbor distance field smoothstepped to zero at water boundaries.
boundary_behavior.outside_mask: Untouched source pixels are copied through.
boundary_behavior.sample_guard: Displacement falls back from 100% to 52%, then 20%, then original source if the bilinear footprint leaves the water mask.

runtime.background_foreground_recovery: Retains elapsed time and re-anchors delta time after foregrounding.

ui.realism_review_control: START / RESUME with WATER ENERGY off
ui.secondary_control: WATER ENERGY increases irregular field strength without reintroducing a periodic model

remaining_risks: Naturalness must be judged on the real phone over 10-20 seconds.
A reviewer may still identify a local grid, temporal beat, or dominant direction.
Canvas2D ImageData timing and output sharpness vary by device.
WATER ENERGY is a diagnostic strength setting, not the realism acceptance setting.
phone_test_procedure: Open the R4B artifact on the target phone from a served repository root.
Start from Static Reference, then use START / RESUME with WATER ENERGY off.
Observe open water, island-adjacent water, and shoreline-adjacent water continuously for 10-20 seconds.
Record visual FAIL if any readable wave center, rings, repeated beat, synchronized motion, grid, dominant travel direction, shoreline tear, or sliding-photo effect remains.
Use PAUSE, STATIC REFERENCE, and DEBUG GEOMETRY for inspection.
Do not begin R5 from this checkpoint.
